objective.text: Restrict accepted hostnames before generating links from the request host.

difficulty.rationale: Separate host acceptance from environment defaults and proxy trust.

runtime.sapi: Isolated CLI Laravel harness unless another context is explicitly stated
runtime.errorPolicy: E_ALL; UTC; no external services or application data

stem: A public application should accept only example.test and its explicitly allowed subdomains. It sometimes generates absolute links from incoming requests. Which application boundary rejects requests with attacker-controlled Host values outside that set?

options.text: Configure trusted-host patterns and run the trusted-host middleware for incoming requests.
options.rationale: Host validation rejects unapproved hostnames before application code relies on them for absolute links.

options.text: Escape the generated URL as HTML without checking its host.
options.rationale: HTML escaping prevents markup interpretation but does not make a destination hostname trusted.
options.misconception: HTML escaping prevents markup interpretation but does not make a destination hostname trusted.

options.text: Trust every proxy header while leaving host acceptance unrestricted.
options.rationale: Proxy trust determines which forwarded data is used; it does not provide the required host allowlist.
options.misconception: Proxy trust determines which forwarded data is used; it does not provide the required host allowlist.

options.text: Set APP_URL to https://example.test and accept every incoming Host.
options.rationale: APP_URL is not a general incoming Host allowlist for HTTP requests.
options.misconception: APP_URL is not a general incoming Host allowlist for HTTP requests.

validation.reason: Trusted-host middleware establishes allowed host patterns; URL escaping and APP_URL address different concerns.
